headline: 61-Year-Old Grandmother Breaks Her Own World Record with 5-Hour Plank
meta_description: A 61-year-old grandmother has shattered her own world record by holding a plank for an astonishing 5 hours, proving age is no barrier to extraordinary achievem…
summary_short: A 61-year-old grandmother has broken her own world record by holding a plank position for a remarkable 5 hours, demonstrating remarkable strength and determination.
body:
A 61-year-old grandmother has broken her own world record by holding a plank position for 5 hours, according to reports shared on r/UpliftingNews. The achievement showcases not only exceptional physical endurance but also the power of setting and surpassing personal goals regardless of age.

The grandmother's dedication to the feat reflects a broader trend of older adults challenging conventional expectations about what the body can accomplish. Her willingness to push past her previous record demonstrates the mental fortitude required for such demanding physical challenges.

This remarkable accomplishment serves as inspiration to people of all ages, proving that strength, determination, and commitment to personal growth know no age limit.
quick_facts: Grandmother surpassed her own previous world record
